concerns.text: Task T002 claims to *‘Download and curate a verified subset of 50 failed figures (FR‑001)’* but the implementation is specified to *‘abort if no verified open‑source URL exists’*. FR‑001 is a MUST requirement; allowing an abort weakens the requirement and leaves the system without the required dataset, violating the specification.

Task T008 states the analysis script *‘creates exactly three JSON objects (one per metric)’* while the implementation plan (plan.md) explicitly requires statistical testing on **four** metrics (time‑to‑success, iteration count, NASA‑TLX, **semantic_success_rate**) with Bonferroni‑adjusted α = 0.025 per test. Producing only three result objects fails to satisfy the plan’s declared scope, constituting a weakening of the analysis requirement.
